segments.text: The LORD said unto my Lord,

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

heading: A Psalm of David. A Messianic Psalm of the Priest-King

segments.text: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion:

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

footnotes.text: + from…: or, more than the womb of the morning: thou shalt have, etc

segments.text: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent,

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
